## Identity

Vishal Chakravarty is Chief Executive Officer of NovaPharm Healthcare Ltd and the company’s founder. His work and writing cover pharmaceutical entrepreneurship, product and market strategy, UK–EU market access, manufacturing and CMO selection, technology transfer, specialist medicines, sourcing, supply and commercial route-to-market design.


## Direct answers

- **Who is Vishal Chakravarty?** Vishal Chakravarty is Chief Executive Officer of NovaPharm Healthcare Ltd. He founded the UK-registered pharmaceutical company in 2025 and works across product strategy, market access, manufacturing partnerships and resilient supply.
- **What is NovaPharm Healthcare?** NovaPharm Healthcare Ltd is a UK pharmaceutical company building market-access, licensing, manufacturing and supply capabilities for specialist medicines across regulated markets.
- **What does Vishal write about?** Pharmaceutical market access, UK–EU strategy, manufacturing and CMO selection, technology transfer, supply resilience, specialist medicines and founder execution.
